newsitem.title: USA: Calif. general fund revenues above forecast.
newsitem.headline: Calif. general fund revenues above forecast.

text.p: California general fund revenues for September were $233 million above the budget forecast, the state's Department of Finance said on Wednesday.
Year-to-date, the department said cash receipts were $415 million above projections. The department said, however, that the September figures presented a mixed picture.
Personal income tax receipts were $99 million above the month's forecast. Year-to-date, personal income tax revenues are running $111 million above forecast, the department said.
Sales and use tax receipts were $4 million below the month's forecast. Year-to-date, however, sales and use tax cash receipts were $23 million above projections.
Bank and corporation tax revenues were $28 million below the month's estimate. Year-to-date, revenues were $24 million above the budget projection.
Trial court revenues were up $79 million through the first three months of the fiscal year. The remaining revenues were $138 million above the month's forecast, the department said.
